scope: Validates vr_bridge_dora.py: lite-vr teleop (mapping/IK) streams joint targets over TCP :9001, the bridge converts them to Forge JointCommand on a Dora action port, mujoco_sim follows, and its proprio_state feeds measured state back to lite-vr. Simulation only; the same bridge/protocol is used by the real-robot dataflow but has not been run against the arm.
chain: fake_headset -> WS :8765 -> lite-vr teleop (pybullet IK) -> TCP :9001 -> vr_bridge_dora -> Dora JointCommand -> mujoco_sim -> proprio_state -> vr_bridge_dora -> lite-vr teleop
environment: conda metavr-arm (teleop), repo .venv python3.12 + dora-cli 0.4.1 (bridge/sim), MUJOCO_GL=egl

preposition.note: Start from the user's measured manipulation pose (handeye_grasp/config/arm.yaml start_pose). At the all-zero pose sigma_min is ~7.6e-5, so a 3 cm hand circle needs large joint motion and IK misses the 3 mm tolerance; this is a pose property, not a bridge effect.

commands.dataflow: MUJOCO_GL=egl PATH="$PWD/../../../.venv/bin:$HOME/.dora/bin:<mujoco_sim-1.1.1 dir>:$PATH" env -u PYTHONPATH dora run dataflow.sim.yaml
commands.teleop: conda run -n metavr-arm python3 launch/run_teleop_webxr.py --source ws --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --real --real-right 127.0.0.1:9001 --viewer gui --probe validation_output/vr_bridge_e2e_probe.jsonl
commands.headset: conda run -n metavr-arm python3 litearm-vr-bridge/scripts/fake_headset.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765 --pattern circle --radius 0.03 --period 4 --duration 14

evidence.teleop_probe: vr_bridge_e2e_probe.jsonl (715+ frames; per-frame mapping, IK and TCP pose)

bridge_tracking.note: Zero-lag error is dominated by end-to-end latency (teleop pipeline + TCP + 50 Hz Dora tick + position-actuator lag), not by transport loss; best alignment is ~70 ms.
